label: The next step for trapezoidal
subgoals: Identify the method order and its error exponent
Take the tolerance-to-error ratio to the power one over order plus one
Multiply the current step by that factor

label: The next step for backward Euler
section: The next step for backward Euler
subgoals: Use exponent one half for a first-order method
Scale the step by the square root of the ratio

label: Rejecting a step
subgoals: Compare the error estimate with the tolerance
Discard the step and compute a smaller step with a safety factor
Retry the step from the last accepted time point
